vibe: Premium, energetic, calm-yet-bold. Tactile minimalism designed for wellness/pilates SaaS.

marketing.grid: Bento Grid Protocol: Asymmetric layouts, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
marketing.spacing: Generous. Use p-12 to p-32 for sections.
marketing.hero_overlay: Max overlay opacity bg-black/30 or gradient to transparent to let the high-quality image breathe.

dashboard.grid: Control Room Grid: High density, gap-4 or gap-6. Direct children only.
dashboard.surfaces: Tactile Solid: Soft backgrounds with crisp 1px borders (border-border/40), no heavy drop shadows. Card radius max 8px (rounded-lg).

components.buttons: Shadcn 'Button' customized to rounded-full for marketing, rounded-lg for dashboard. Hover states must explicitly lighten background.
components.glassmorphism: Only used for sticky nav or modals over imagery: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px inner border.
components.testing: All interactive elements, forms, and cards MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='create-class-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for high-end lightweight icons.
Update tailwind.config.js and index.css with the provided HSL color variables.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the Marketing landing page (bento grid, overlapping layout).
Use deeply customized Shadcn components for the Dashboard and AI Wizard.
Ensure 'data-testid' is strictly added for every button, form field, and interactive feature.
Do not use generic blue/gray SaaS defaults. Adhere strictly to the Deep Forest Green/Sage/Sand palette to evoke calm-yet-bold wellness.
